field: tools/build_report.py:108-109 and 244-250; Candidates that need clarification, c176, What is unsettled
correct_value: Criterion 2 is unclear: 75 students (25 per arm) are sample/allocation counts; final analyzed headcounts and exclusions are not reported. Authors must confirm that at least 50 people were analyzed (pp. 1, 6, 10-13).
evidence: The assembled report, line 1003, displays only the beginning of the statement that criterion 1 is met. In forms/c176.json eligibility.reason, the sentence identifying criterion 2 as unclear starts at character offset 345, after the builder truncates the reason to 240 characters. final.criteria.at_least_50_people is unclear, and final.open_items[0] requires author confirmation of final analyzed headcounts and exclusions. Independently read the c176 PDF identified in retrieval.json: PDF pp. 1 and 6 report the 75-student sample and 25 per group, while Tables 4-7 on pp. 10-13 print results without final analyzed headcounts. Table 5 p. 11 prints error df = 72, not an explicit analyzed-person count. The form records the unsettled criterion correctly; the table truncation removes it.

The assembled report, lines 1004 and 1561, presents the supplied-ideas question as unresolved and classifies c002 as clarify. In forms/c002.json, final.core is yes and every final criterion is met. final.open_items[5] explicitly resolves the question in favor of eligibility and has settled_by = nothing_needed, but its affects_eligibility flag is true. creativity-codebook.md section 6, line 105, explicitly defines ideas_supplied to include AI-generated ideas or examples; section 3 accepts randomized within-person order. Independently read the c002 PDF identified in retrieval.json: PDF p. 5, Figure 2 and sections 3.4.2-3.4.3, reports randomized trial sequences and manipulated exposure to AI-generated examples; PDF p. 7, Tables 1-2, documents output-based measures and 844 unique participants. The contradictory flag is the only true eligibility flag. Running the existing classify function in memory reproduces clarify; changing only this flag to false returns core. Regenerating the report after that form correction should move c002 to the core recommendation and show core in reclassification.
